largeCalendar.scope: Synthetic fixture host only. No real Apple Calendar writes or Obsidian runtime integration.

bugsFixed: During workspace restoration a deferred calendar was previously invisible to getLeavesOfType, so an old timer leaf could convert into a second calendar. Saved/deferred leaves are now discovered through iterateAllLeaves/getViewState; migration runs after the restoration turn.
Timer migration now checks the active leaf after deferred calendar loading; switching to a native note during that wait does not steal focus.
The embedded timer record and current-target calendar actions open the large calendar on the correct day, preserving the actual-work history view.
limits: Browser tests use synthetic notes and timers.
Native checks preserve the existing paused user session and only open/switch/refresh views; no start/pause/stop or real Apple event was triggered.
Release publication and hosted CI are verified separately from these local checks.
